EN.note: Re-pinned 2026-11-06 from 93a723b8 to a7489b79, the commit tagged 450.02 on edge-next (owner approved 450.02 for bench control, 2026-11-05). fb is 450.02 (tinyg.h:52). It fixes the feed-hold endpoint drift (N66), refuses a persisted setting written during a cycle with status 117 (N60), reports stored settings that would not load with status 118 after the banner (N61), applies G10 offsets sent during a dwell at once, and range-checks the axis rate, junction deviation, radius, chordal tolerance, ja, work offset and PWM frequency setters. No token is added or removed. The re-pin before (6ec70652 to 93a723b8) added the feed-limit report and push (rt flk, flm, flp, flf, fi, fs). D4 is done (owner, 2026-11-01). Still open and separate: the fbs and cap identity tokens D4 recommends (not in this build), D5 image approval (no image has passed it) and the D6 published release. The bench manifest approves this commit only, and classification never relies on fb alone (PN §2.3): make FW_BUILD overrides the number.
